items.title: Christian McCaffrey: Questionable to return Sunday
items.description:
McCaffrey (thigh) is questionable to return to Sunday's contest in Atlanta, Jennifer Lee Chan of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

items.title: Aaron Rodgers: Limited production in Week 7 win
items.description:
Rodgers completed 19 of 30 passes for 212 passes and a touchdown in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Saints. He added six yards on three carries.

items.title: Christian McCaffrey: Exits with apparent leg injury
items.description:
McCaffrey was getting his lower left leg worked on during the first half of Sunday's game in Atlanta, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Jaylen Warren: Piles up yardage in Paris
items.description:
Warren carried the ball 18 times for 101 yards and caught three of four targets for 36 yards in Sunday's 16-10 win over the Saints.

items.title: Braelon Allen: Handling lead role again Sunday
items.description:
Allen will remain the Jets' No. 1 back for Sunday's Week 7 matchup against the Dolphins, as Breece Hall has been declared inactive for the contest.
